To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
reflexivity is an important part of the research process.
reflexivity in qualitative research is a continuous process and an integral part of the research.
reflexivity in qualitative research is a journey of learning.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the process of reflexivity, the process of reflecting on the role of the researcher in research and the role of the research process in shaping the researcher.
the process of reflexivity and how we as qualitative researchers have been affected by the research process.
the following questions: How does the researcher change as a result of his/her involvement in the research process?
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

reflexivity is a continuous process that involves self awareness, introspection, and the recognition that as a researcher, one is part of the social phenomenon being studied and that one's social background and location affect the research process.

reflexivity is a process of critical self awareness and self examination of the researcher's positionality in relation to the research process, the research participants, the findings of the research and the research outputs.
reflexivity is a process of reflection by the researchers on how their social background, location and values affect their research practice.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
reflexivity is about the researcher being aware of his/her positionality and the role of the self in the research process and the research output.
it is a journey of learning and of discovering.

reflexivity is the process of being aware of the role and influence of the researchers' subjectivity and social location in the research process (Hesse Bier, 2007) and of the ways in which the research process influences the researchers (Ackerly, True, 2011; Frank, 2000; Morse, 2007; Shaffir, Stebbins, Turowetz, 1991).
The main takeaway from our work is that
we are not "objective" in our research, but we are aware of our subjectivity and how it affects the research process.
the process of reflexivity is not a one-time event.
the researcher's role and reflexivity is an integral part of the research process.
